scenes.title: Bounded autonomy
scenes.accessibleDescription: An authorized goal, scope, and stop conditions let work continue safely.

scenes.title: A durable loop
scenes.accessibleDescription: Build, verify, and checkpoint in meaningful units of progress.

scenes.title: Work around a blocker
scenes.accessibleDescription: Record the owner action and continue independent authorized work.

scenes.title: Recover before retry
scenes.accessibleDescription: An interrupted request may already have changed an external system.

scenes.title: Protect the reserve
scenes.accessibleDescription: Check shared usage at batch boundaries and preserve completion capacity.

scenes.title: Morning proof report
scenes.accessibleDescription: Give the owner a clear account of outcomes, evidence, and remaining work.

scenes.title: Overnight contract
scenes.accessibleDescription: Describe the approved goal and conditions before an unattended build.

scenes.title: Useful checkpoints
scenes.accessibleDescription: Each checkpoint gives the next session a dependable restart point.

scenes.title: Continue elsewhere
scenes.accessibleDescription: A missing credential can block one integration without blocking all work.

scenes.title: An uncertain request
scenes.accessibleDescription: A timeout can hide a successful external effect; investigate first.

scenes.title: Use the reserve
scenes.accessibleDescription: Apply a configurable budget policy before and after each batch.

scenes.title: Make review easy
scenes.accessibleDescription: Put the result and artifact links first for the person returning later.

scenes.title: Resume from reality
scenes.accessibleDescription: Compare the handoff with the actual workspace before taking the next step.
